generationPrompts.logo:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: final website brand symbol for WholePlan, a minimal connected-purchase planning app.
Primary request: design one original, beautifully proportioned geometric W monogram, formed by three interlocking ribbon-like folded modules that read as one continuous whole. Strong memorable silhouette. It must look clear at 24 pixels.
Style: exceptionally clean flat vector-like brand design, precise smooth edges, balanced negative space, professional financial software identity.
Palette: cobalt blue #003ee8, deep navy #001c64, a restrained bright blue #009cde accent. Only these solid colors.
Composition: a single standalone mark centered, filling about 78 percent of a square canvas. Transparent background with real alpha.
Constraints: no text, no letters besides the abstract W shape, no wordmark, no arrows, no existing payment-provider logos, no rounded-square app container, no gradients, no glow, no drop shadows, no mockup, no presentation board, no watermark. Return only the finished transparent logo asset.
generationPrompts.hero:
Use case: product-mockup.
Asset type: transparent landing-page hero illustration for WholePlan, a minimal connected-purchase planning app.
Primary request: create a polished sculptural arrangement of three connected physical objects representing a concert ticket, a hotel key card, and a travel boarding card. This is a quiet premium studio product render for an editorial website.
Subject: one oversized warm-white ticket with elegantly rounded corners and subtle perforated edge in front, one vivid cobalt blue hotel key card behind it, and one translucent pale-blue boarding card behind that, assembled in a precise slightly fanned stack. On the white ticket is a tiny cobalt abstract interlocking W symbol, a large fine-line ticket icon, and a short embossed series of clean horizontal lines. On the other cards are a fine-line key/door icon and a transport route icon. All icons are restrained and integral to the surface.
Composition: square canvas, centered full product with comfortable 10 percent clear margin on every side. Three-quarter studio angle, slightly tilted, like a premium hardware launch. This illustration will sit to the right of large typography.
Lighting/materials: soft directional daylight, subtle realistic paper fibers, satin blue edges, gentle highlights, refined physical thickness, clean tiny contact shadows between objects. No visible ground plane. Transparent background with genuine alpha. Keep outer shadow very subtle.
Colors: cobalt #003ee8, navy #001c64, pale ice blue and off-white. Minimal and functional. No bright decorative colors.
Constraints: no readable text, no invented labels, no prices, no UI screenshot, no website layout, no human hands, no coins or banknotes, no credit card numbers, no existing brand logos, no PayPal logo, no extraneous objects, no border, no glow, no watermark. Return a single finished product illustration asset.

heroTransparencyRefinement:

Remove the isolated tiny cyan, blue, white and red specks floating outside the three-card product silhouette, especially above the top card and along the far left edge. Make all pixels away from the product genuinely transparent. Make the object cutout clean and anti-aliased without colored fringe.

socialPrompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset type: final social sharing / Open Graph banner for the WholePlan website.
Inputs: Image 1 is the finished three-card product artwork to preserve. Image 2 is the official WholePlan W mark to preserve.
Create a wide landscape banner with an approximately 1200 by 630 pixel (1.905:1) composition.
Background: uniform very light ice-grey #f3f5f8, minimal and uncluttered.
Top-left: the supplied W logo at a modest size followed by the exact lowercase wordmark "wholeplan." in bold clean sans-serif, deep navy.
Left central area: large beautifully spaced modern sans-serif headline, exactly two lines reading "Every piece." and "One whole plan." First line deep navy #111c31, second line cobalt #003ee8. Keep every letter crisp and correct.
Right central area: use the supplied three-card artwork from Image 1, full uncropped product, vertically centered, scaled to fit with comfortable negative space, preserving its exact bus, hotel key, ticket symbols and small W logo. Add only a very subtle studio shadow.
Bottom-left: small uppercase text exactly "THE TICKET. THE STAY. THE WAY HOME."
Typography should occupy the left 60 percent, artwork the right 35 percent. Large margins, editorial precision, no other decorations.
Constraints: preserve the supplied logo identity and product. No payment provider logos, no extra text, no labels, no badges, no watermark. Flat solid background, finished publication-ready banner.
